recap.narration_text: Minor unlicensed driving denial preserves permit. Serious minor violation has shorter of. Serious crash charge can prevent issuance. For a minor’s driving-without-valid-credential denial, a license cannot be requested until eighteen, but a permit remains available and an existing license is reduced to permit privileges. A minor’s serious-moving-violation denial lasts nine months or until eighteen, whichever comes first, and restricts license applications while allowing a permit or reducing an existing license to permit privileges. A charge after a crash seriously injuring or killing another person may cause denial of license issuance or renewal even without alcohol involvement.
